decisions.reason: Conferencing draws on the firm's voice know-how, but by 2022 it faces intense competition from cloud collaboration platforms, and the firm has no website evidence to learn from, so withdrawal risk is substantial, though not yet decisive.

The metro data centre network builds directly on owned fibre and carrier-neutral data centre knowledge and has documented customer adoption, giving the firm strong capacity to assimilate results and expand it.
Optical spectrum connectivity extends core fibre engineering expertise toward high-bandwidth services, matching the firm's strategic direction and in-house technical knowledge.
The number ordering portal uses the firm's software platforms and regulatory know-how for real-time provisioning, though it could be folded into a broader digital portal over time.

Direct voice connectivity rests on established voice infrastructure and enterprise relationships, but declining legacy voice demand adds moderate risk, as the earlier withdrawal of the carrier pre-selection service shows.
